reference: User-supplied 1 Call.mp3 analysed as a complete mix, not separated or subjectively auditioned

changes.beat_existing_side: 250Hz highpassed side added with coefficient 10^(5/20)-1; no synthetic delay. Phase-dependent transition, not an exact brickwall width boost.
changes.vocal: V6 OPEN + 1900Hz Q.9 +0.6dB, loudness matched then raised .25dB; no new reverb

limiter.method: 1 ms stereo least-squares gain relative to driven input; active blocks > -50 dBFS. Approximate limiter gain reduction, includes resampling differences.

limitations: Reference band levels include different instrumentation, arrangements and vocals; not an exact vocal EQ target. No claim of verified perceptual similarity.
